arStrings.szText:
Casting an {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill or {c_important}Evading{/c} shoots {c_number}[SF_11]{/c} {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c}, each dealing {c_random}{payload:VULNERABLE_PAYLOAD_TOOLTIP}{/c} Lightning damage and applying {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} seconds. Can only occur once every {c_number}[SF_14|1|]{/c} seconds. The {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c} Movement Speed bonus is doubled and always active. 

All Skills are now also {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skills.
